result: Failed while checking the pre-existing rest transport because its members use the public/ prefix. The builder incorrectly assumed pre-existing transports always had no prefix. The pre-existing color review transport uses the same public/ prefix.
successor: The v2 builder recognizes both prefix forms and verifies every archive member against source bytes and modes. The failed partial output and original builder are retained in restricted authenticated originals.
capture_qualification: Tool-visible failure text was transcribed in the restricted process record; it was not separately saved byte-for-byte at execution. The failure is a packaging issue, not product behavior.
